issues: MATH ERROR in appendix.tex:283, not caught by the checker. The claimed bound sum_{j in F}|hat h(j..j) hat w(j)| <= (p/4)||omega||^2 is false for n>=2 under the paper's unnormalised DFT. A numerical test with the Cauchy-Schwarz-optimal w reaches 5.86 at p=11, n=2 (paper's bound 2.75) and 25.85 at p=23, n=2 (paper's bound 5.75). The paper's own argument gives p^n/4: hat h(j..j) is the DFT of G(s)=p^{n-1}E[h|S=s], so sum_{j!=0}|hat h(j..j)|^2 = p^{2n} Var(E[h|S]) <= p^{2n-1} sum_t ||u_t||^2. Hence C_2 <= 2p^{-(n+1)} p^n/4 = 1/(2p), independent of n; the paper's p^{-n}/2 agrees only at n=1. Only the constant is affected: Cor dense (the flat maximizer) does not depend on C_2, so the 'b=nu endpoint' sentence survives. The checker's recommended_change calls this constant the new part, so it must use 1/(2p).
